snippet.title: Terminal Outbreak Demo Release
snippet.description:
We here at Studio Campfire are proud to announce that a playable demo of our game 'Terminal Outbreak' will be available February 13th (this Friday!)
Along with this our demo will also be participating in #steamnextfest in the coming weeks!
We hope you will all try it out!

Check out the Steam Page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479820/Terminal_Outbreak/

#gamedev #demo #gametrailer #indie #indiegame #speedrun
